firebase.description: Preserves the existing PolityMarket Firebase CLI MCP command without changing its tools or credentials.
prerequisites: Existing Firebase CLI on PATH and its existing authenticated project context.

auth.status_hint: Uses existing Firebase CLI credentials; this admission grants no new provider permissions.

firebase.risk: Existing Firebase project read/write tools; writes require the owner's scoped instruction. Do not run production data updates or paid calls for CI tests.
